general.label: General preparation
general.focus: Choose the organisation and role you want to practise for.

db.label: Deutsche Bank
db.focus: Practice around Deutsche Bank’s published investment banking, Fixed Income & Currencies and Corporate Bank businesses.
db.why: Why Deutsche Bank? Use something about its business mix or clients.

bofa.label: Bank of America / Merrill
bofa.focus: Corporate funding, lending and global-markets practice. Technical stretch adds numerical follow-ups; it does not assume a particular interview style.
bofa.why: Why Bank of America for this role?

gs.label: Goldman Sachs
gs.focus: Investment banking, markets and investment-management scenarios, matched to the division you choose.
priorities: Clear, structured answers on video (HireVue first round)
gs.why: Why Goldman Sachs, and why this division specifically?

jpm.label: J.P. Morgan
jpm.focus: Client advisory, financing, markets, payments and investment-management practice, depending on the role.
priorities: Why J.P. Morgan and the specific business
A view on markets or a recent deal
jpm.why: Why J.P. Morgan, and why this team? Give a reason specific to J.P. Morgan rather than to any big bank.

barclays.label: Barclays
barclays.focus: Investment banking, markets and international corporate-banking practice, with client funding and cash-flow scenarios.
barclays.why: Why Barclays rather than a US bank? Give a reason linked to its UK and international business.

ubs.label: UBS
ubs.focus: Banking, markets and wealth or investment-management practice. Client objectives and suitability matter in the investment cases.
ubs.why: Why UBS? Link it to its wealth management focus.

ey.label: EY
ey.focus: Evidence, professional judgement, critical thinking and the chosen audit, tax or advisory role.
priorities: Skills: how you approach work and learn
Why EY and this service line
ey.why: Why EY, and why this service line? Give a reason specific to EY.

pwc.label: PwC
pwc.focus: Audit, tax and deals scenarios centred on evidence, judgement and explaining your reasoning to a client or team.
priorities: Why PwC and the service line
pwc.why: Why PwC, and why this service line?

blackrock.label: BlackRock
blackrock.focus: Asset management: active and index investing (iShares), private markets, client portfolios and the Aladdin technology platform.
priorities: Genuine interest in markets and investing (have a view)
Active vs index investing, fees and risk
Teamwork and how you learn fast
blackrock.why: Why BlackRock, and why asset management rather than investment banking? Be specific about the part of BlackRock you want to work in.

rothschild.label: Rothschild & Co
rothschild.focus: Independent, family-controlled financial advisory: M&A, debt advisory and restructuring, plus wealth and asset management.
priorities: Why independent advice, not a bulge-bracket bank
A deal you have followed, explained clearly
Polish, discretion and attention to detail
rothschild.why: Why Rothschild & Co rather than a large bank with a balance sheet? What does independent advice give a client?

lazard.label: Lazard
lazard.focus: Independent financial advisory (M&A, restructuring, sovereign advisory) and asset management.
lazard.why: Why Lazard? What would you get from a smaller independent adviser that you would not get at a larger bank?

evercore.label: Evercore
evercore.focus: Independent investment banking advisory: M&A, restructuring and capital markets advice.
evercore.why: Why Evercore and independent advisory rather than a bulge-bracket bank?

ms.label: Morgan Stanley
ms.focus: Investment banking, sales & trading, wealth management and investment management.
priorities: Motivation and knowledge of the division
Values: doing the right thing, putting clients first
ms.why: Why Morgan Stanley? Use something specific about how the firm is built, not just its reputation.

citi.label: Citi
citi.focus: A global network bank: banking, markets and services (payments, trade and cash for multinationals).
citi.why: Why Citi? Use its global network or services business in your answer.

hsbc.label: HSBC
hsbc.focus: International bank connecting clients across markets, with a strong Asia franchise; banking, markets and corporate banking.
hsbc.why: Why HSBC? Link your answer to its international network.

deloitte.label: Deloitte
deloitte.focus: Audit & assurance, consulting, tax and financial advisory, with strengths and behaviour-based interviews.
priorities: Why Deloitte and the service line
deloitte.why: Why Deloitte, and why this service line?

kpmg.label: KPMG
kpmg.focus: Audit, tax and advisory (including deal advisory), with values and judgement in the interviews.
kpmg.why: Why KPMG, and why this service line?
